title: Bay Play
specs: 3,000 square foot custom indoor playground with slides, zip lines, and toddler area
Two-story ninja warrior course with obstacles for different ages
Bouldering wall with large air bag for safe landings
Arcade with classic and new games and redemption prizes
All guests must fill out a waiver prior to arrival
All guests must wear Bay Play Grip Socks provided by the facility
Climbing walls require participants to weigh at least 40 pounds and less than 300 pounds
All guests under 16 must be accompanied by an adult
Party rooms or tables reserved for 45 minutes, plus approx. 2 hours playtime before seating
Guest of honor allowed 2 chaperones; each participant allowed 1 chaperone

services.name: Day Passes
services.desc: All guests must fill out a WAIVER. ALL GUESTS even chaperones. We recommend that you complete the waiver online before your arrival. Once you complete the waiver it is valid for one year. You can fill out the waiver HERE. All participating guests must wear Bay Play Grip Socks. Do not bring your own, You will be required to wear our grip socks. You keep the socks. Bring them for every visit. ALL GUESTS MUST REMOVE THEIR SHOES AT THE ENTRANCE. YES, EVEN THE CHAPERONES. WE TAKE EVERY STEP TO KEEP OUR FACILITY CLEAN. THE KIDDOS CRAWL ON THE FLOOR ETC. Outside food and drink is NOT allowed. We will make an exception for small snacks, the kids will get hungry. Eating and drinking is not allowed

Birthday parties include reserved rooms or tables, pizza, juice boxes, and game cards.
